themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in both the United States and Sweden are promoting populist financial relief and tax cuts to mobilize working-class voters ahead of crucial elections. While Donald Trump and his allies market a $5,000 election dividend for citizens, the Sweden Democrats are proposing targeted tax cuts on essential goods, fuel, and electricity.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposing direct tax cuts on fuel, electricity, and food to reduce household expenses before the election.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Promoting a $5,000 citizen dividend and tax relief promises as key midterm campaign talking points.

themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Sweden and the US are making strategic pushes to consolidate political influence and establish far-right ideas within mainstream governance. As Sweden Democrats poll near a historic parliamentary breakthrough to enter cabinet discussions, the MAGA movement is using RNC conventions to lock in party unity and elevate successor figures like JD Vance.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Polling neck-and-neck with left-wing blocs, positioning the party for direct influence in government.

themes.title: Nationalist Pressures to Reshape Immigration Policies and Border Control
themes.blurb: Restrictive border framing and anti-immigrant rhetoric remain core strategic anchors for right-wing movements across borders. In Sweden, the ascent of the Sweden Democrats marks a fundamental departure from the nation's traditionally open refugee policies, while MAGA figures in the US continue to advocate strict enforcement and paint immigration as a threat to national stability.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Driving a national policy shift away from open asylum policies toward hardline border restrictions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Employing aggressive rhetoric against illegal immigration and defending strict administration enforcement.
